common.adminOnly: Only owners and admins can change this.

sheet.desc: Track hours against a project and a task, with the timer or by typing them.
sheet.durationHint: 1:30, 1.5 or 90m. Leave it empty to start a timer.
sheet.durationInvalid: Type a duration like 1:30, 1.5 or 90m, up to 24 hours.
sheet.emptyDayBody: Start a timer or type the hours you worked.
sheet.noProjectsAdmin: Create a project to start tracking time against it.
sheet.noProjectsMember: Ask an owner or admin of the workspace to create a project or add you to one.
sheet.deleteBody: The hours go away from the timesheet and the reports.
sheet.notAssignedAdmin: Open a project and add yourself to its team to track time on it.

week.copied: {count, plural, one {# row copied} other {# rows copied}}
week.nothingToCopy: There is no earlier timesheet with hours to copy.
week.emptyBody: Add a row for each project and task, then type the hours under each day.
week.lockedLabel: {project}, {task}, {day}. Several entries or a running timer: open the day to edit
week.removeTitle: Delete this row for the week?
week.removeBody: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} ({duration}) are deleted from this week.
week.rowExists: That project and task already have a row this week.
week.hint: Type 1:30, 1.5 or 90m. Notes and timers are in the day view.

projects.desc: Each project with its client, rate and budget.
projects.emptyBody: Add a project with its client, hourly rate and budget in hours.
projects.emptyMember: Only owners and admins create projects. Ask one of them to add the first.
projects.name: Name
projects.billableHint: Hours on this project count as billable when the task is billable too.
projects.rateHint: In {currency}. Leave it empty for no amount.
projects.budgetHint: Optional. The list shows how much is used.
projects.deleteBody: Its {hours} hours are deleted too, for everyone. To keep them, archive the project instead.
projects.noTime: No hours on this project yet.

reports.desc: Hours, billable hours and amount for a range.
reports.emptyBody: Pick another range, or track time in the timesheet.
reports.onlyYours: You see your own hours. Owners and admins see the whole team.

settings.desc: Tasks, clients and the currency of your rates.
settings.tasksDesc: Every project uses these tasks. A non-billable task makes its hours non-billable.
settings.clientsDesc: Clients group projects in the list and in reports.
settings.currencyDesc: The currency of hourly rates and amounts.
settings.deleteTaskBody: It has no hours. To hide a task with hours, archive it.
settings.deleteClientBody: Its projects stay, without a client.
settings.projectsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}

errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.not_found: It doesn't exist anymore. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: Only owners and admins can do this.
errors.project_archived: That project is archived. Restore it to track time on it.
errors.task_archived: That task is archived. Restore it in Settings to use it.
errors.too_long: An entry can't be longer than 24 hours.
errors.in_use: This task has hours. Archive it instead.
errors.duplicate: There's already one with that name.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many changes in a row. Wait a minute.
errors.not_assigned: You're not on this project's team. Ask an owner or admin to add you.
errors.task_not_in_project: That task isn't on this project. Pick another one.

assign.everyoneHint: Every person in the workspace who can use Time tracks hours here.
assign.onlyPeopleHint: Only the people checked below see the project and track hours on it.
assign.allTasksHint: Every active task, billable as set in Settings.
assign.onlyTasksHint: Pick the tasks for this project and whether each one is billable here.
